As a holding company, the company formulates and executes the group's consolidated management strategy and conducts real estate leasing; its 100%-owned subsidiary McDonald's Japan Co., Ltd. operates stores under the company-operated store model and expands stores under the franchise model. The company pays royalties to McDonald's Corporation of the United States for licenses it grants, and it grants sub-licenses of know-how and trademarks to domestic franchisees, from which it receives royalties. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥416,602 million.
